about_short_description.short_description: Arzag plus is a food and a beverage company that offers food stuffs for restaurants, food trucks, hotels, and cafes.

product.name: Distribution and Supply Services
product.description: Provides distribution and supply of food products to restaurants, cafes, hotels, and food trucks across Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Product Catalog
product.description: An extensive catalog of food products including fresh ingredients and specialized items for food service businesses.

product.name: Scheduled Delivery Solutions
product.description: Offers scheduled and specialized delivery services to ensure timely supply of food products to clients.

product.name: Data Analytics Platform
product.description: Provides data analytics and insights to help food businesses make informed decisions based on customer preferences and market trends.

product.name: Inventory Management and Warehousing
product.description: Manages inventory storage and order fulfillment through advanced warehousing facilities to streamline supply chain operations.

product.name: Flexible Payment Solutions
product.description: Offers multiple payment options including traditional and digital methods to facilitate transactions for clients.
